input_fields.name: result_object_set
input_fields.description: Actual Boolean result objects with type/topology/volume/bounds properties.

input_fields.name: expected_geometry_relation
input_fields.description: One expected result relation and tolerances.

result_fields.name: measured_predicate
result_fields.description: Semantic fields, tolerances, and expected relation.

result_fields.name: selected_result
result_fields.description: Unique result identity or null when unresolved.

result_fields.name: needs_manual_review
result_fields.description: True when results cannot distinguish one semantic result.

procedure: Measure results using expected type, closure, volume, bounds, centroid, adjacency, or topology relation.
Emit one predicate with a uniqueness assertion; never use result[0].
Return selected_result, measured_predicate, tolerance, and rejected candidates.
If relation does not distinguish one result, return needs_manual_review and choose none.
rejection_rules: Reject incomplete result set, missing/negative tolerance, order-based classification, or zero/multiple matches.
Do not relabel an arbitrary result to hide a failed Boolean.
